title: Agents
description: Every AI agent identity registered in this workspace.

createDialog.title: Register a new agent
createDialog.description: Creates the agent record in PENDING_ENROLLMENT status. It won't be able to act until you generate an enrollment token and the agent process completes enrollment out-of-band.
createDialog.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

detail.certUnavailable: Certificate details are issued directly to the agent process during enrollment over mTLS (POST /agents/enroll) and are not retrievable through this console: manar-api exposes no endpoint that returns a live agent's certificate metadata.
detail.notFoundBody: No agent with this ID was found in this workspace's agent list.

enrollment.generateDisabledHint: Only agents pending enrollment can have a token generated.
enrollment.warning: This token is shown only once. Copy it now and hand it to the agent process out-of-band. Manar cannot display it again after you close this dialog.

revoke.dialogDescription: The agent's certificates immediately stop being accepted. This cannot be undone from this console.

killSwitch.activated: Kill switch on. The agent's next action will be refused.

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.dialogBody: The agent can act again on its next request, within its task and policies. The release is recorded in the audit log with your name.
quarantine.noActive: This agent has no active quarantine. Someone may have released it already. The panel has been refreshed.
quarantine.loadError: Couldn't load the quarantine status. Don't assume the agent is clear.
quarantine.roleNote: Quarantine details are visible to Security Admins and Tenant Owners.

network.title: Network
network.roleNote: Network status and the egress allow-list are visible to Security Admins and Tenant Owners.
network.notOnEdgeBody: This agent has no peer on the Manar edge. Its traffic does not pass through the Manar gateway, so the allow-list below is not applied to it.
network.allowListBody: While the agent is on the edge, the gateway lets it reach only these hosts. Every change is recorded in the audit trail.
network.hostHint: A DNS name such as api.example.com, or *. followed by a DNS name. No IPs, ports or paths. Manar checks the name again when you add it.
network.hostInvalid: Enter a DNS name such as api.example.com or *.example.com. IPs, ports, paths and internal names are not accepted.
network.duplicate: This host is already on the allow-list.
network.decisionsEmpty: No egress decisions recorded for this agent yet.
